findings.consequence: Explicitly mounted producer requests can be refused as 404 before their retained producer runs.
findings.evidence: Immutable source plus installed LoadConfiguration/Application/Container mechanics; root reports the completed 760 run has 16 producer 404 failures. The run classification is not a reviewer execution.
findings.finding: Admission recognizes only an already-instantiated env value. LoadConfiguration calls detectEnvironment; Application writes through Container::offsetSet, storing a standard binding closure rather than necessarily an instances entry. The explicit new root fixture instantiates env and masks this ordinary cold-bootstrap representation.
findings.repair: Raw-admit instances and bindings arrays before indexing; accept either the retained literal env instance or the authenticated standard offsetSet binding descriptor and its captured literal value, without invoking the closure or resolving env.
findings.requirement: Admit genuine local/testing Laravel bootstrap without resolving services.

findings.finding: The helper indexes instances[config] before is_array(instances). A noncanonical ArrayAccess value can execute offsetGet before the guard and before original timing capture, even if admission ultimately refuses.
findings.repair: Require actual raw maps before every own offset, including the standard environment binding descriptor. Add a targeted offset sentinel and genuine standard-binding positive.
findings.requirement: Callback-free literal mount admission before budget/policy/identity/body work.

findings.finding: RequestContext evaluates request.server.get(REQUEST_TIME_FLOAT) before entering RequestBudget::capture and therefore before that factory samples hrtime. ServerBag::get is virtual. A subclass can execute arbitrary work or return a replacement/fallback instant before the budget starts. With an unchanged valid server instant the later wall-age deduction may account for delay; that does not make this virtual getter callback-free or generally preserve the original allowance.
findings.repair: Raw-read the Request server property without a property hook, require the supported exact bag and raw parameters array, and obtain the primitive start field without virtual getters or coercion. Retain the existing factory clock/arithmetic and one-use tombstone. Add callback sentinel/refusal and normal-bag positive; retain a genuine elapsed post-capture delay regression.
findings.requirement: Capture original monotonic allowance before callback-producing intake work.

findings.evidence: Immutable a565/760 diff and installed Symfony Response signature; original autoload diagnostic and empty-JUnit outcomes are root-reported, not a reviewer reproduction.
findings.finding: a565 declares private __clone while Symfony Response declares public __clone. The visibility restriction prevents class loading.
findings.repair: The inspected 760 successor makes __clone public, detaches only the clone holder before throwing, and rejects serialization/deserialization. This closes the identified visibility issue at source level.
findings.state: historical a565 source blocker; narrow 760 repair inspected, runtime verification not performed by reviewer

findings.finding: Changing the promoted constructor argument to nullable permits construction without a holder; its constructor catch still calls owner.close unconditionally. Existing controller callers pass a holder, so this is an API/cleanup-contract defect rather than evidence of an ordinary caller authorization bypass.
findings.repair: Keep constructor parameter PaidTaxResponseOwner non-null, assign it to a separate nullable private property before callbacks, and use null only to detach a refused clone. Preserve explicit close/destructor idempotence.
findings.requirement: Owned responses always receive a mandatory plain original holder.
